results.title: issue with rwa api call
results.details:
My API key appears active for Startup (hackathon grant), but RWA endpoints fail while standard endpoints succeed.

1) GET /v1/key/info → HTTP 200 (plan shows monthly credits consistent with Startup)
2) GET /v1/cryptocurrency/map?limit=1 → HTTP 200
3) GET /v5/real-world-assets/map → HTTP 402, error_code 1003, "Your API Key must be activated. Please go to pro.coinmarketcap.com/account/plan."
4) Same 402/1003 for /v5/real-world-assets/info, /issuers/list, /issuers
